fields.title: BarberShop Website + booking
fields.description: Africa Barber Shop was our first client. The owner, Sami, wanted to respect his customers' time by avoiding unnecessary booking hassles and long waits. To solve this, we built a website where clients can easily view available times and reserve their own dedicated time slot, ensuring a seamless and efficient experience for everyone.

fields.title: Serja Website
fields.client: Serja Construction and General Trading PLC
fields.description: Serja Construction and General Trading PLC required a strong digital presence to represent their brand and expertise professionally. To meet this need, we delivered a clean, modern, and fully customized website. The new site serves as a powerful digital storefront, effectively communicating the company's core values, showcasing their services, and speaking directly to their target audience.

fields.title: mini market ERP
fields.description: Noah Mini Market, a growing local business, previously relied on manual, paper-based processes for their daily operations and system analysis. To modernize their workflow, we developed a comprehensive custom ERP solution. This digital transformation replaced their paper trails, streamlining their data management and providing a centralized, efficient platform to run their business.
